messages.subject: Issues with WarbleR (seewave extension package)
messages.body_plain:
Dear seewave users,

I don't know if this is the right place to post this, but I am struggling a lot with some errors I get while using WarbleR that I don't know how to solve. For example: when I try to use compare.methods(), I get an error that there are NA's in my selection table, even though there are none. My supervisor (I'm writing my master's thesis) and smart R friends also don't know how to solve it, so I'm a bit desperate. I was hoping that maybe someone here has any experience with warbleR and could take a look at my script/files/selection table? That would be amazing.

Thanks in advance,

Roos

messages.body_plain:
Dear Marco,

If I run compare.methods, I get the error "Error in eigen(-x/2, symmetric = TRUE) :

  infinite or missing values in 'x'". However there are no NA's or anything, so I don't understand why it gives this error.

En als ik de funcite params wil runnen geeft hij de warning message 'Warning message:
In (0:(n - 1)) * f : NAs produced by integer overflow'.

If I run cross correlation I get this error: Error in if (ncol(spc1$amp) > ncol(spc2$amp)) { :

  argument is of length zero

This I also do not understand. The data.frame/selection table has the right class (also if I compare it to the example giving in the vignette) and I don't see any NA's or missing values.

I have attached a zip file containing my R script, the audio files and the excel sheets that I use for my dataframe. 'New_frequencies_dataframe' is the dataframe that has the bottom frequencies calculated one by one in R and the 'littleowls.selection' is the dataframe that only has the audio files that R could calculate the bottom frequencies of.

I really hope that you can help me! That would be amazing!

Kind regards,

Roos
